content.title: Management Summary
content.content:
**Management Summary**

SnapLogic is an enterprise integration platform enabling Airbus Helicopters to modernize data integration while maintaining on-premises control. This proposal demonstrates SnapLogic's fit across Airbus's stated technical and organizational requirements.

- **Genuine on-premises execution**: Ground Plex runs entirely within Airbus's data center on RedHat OpenShift. No customer data transits SnapLogic's cloud. The cloud-hosted Manager handles only metadata (pipeline definitions, schedules, user accounts). This architecture meets Airbus's data sovereignty and regulatory compliance requirements.

- **Enterprise maturity and scale**: Founded 2006 by Gaurav Dhillon (co-founder of Informatica). 600+ enterprise customers. $100M+ ARR milestone reached August 2025. 21+ customers spending $1M+ annually. Processes 5 trillion records/month — evidence of production-scale platform maturity.

- **AI-first competitive differentiator**: SnapGPT is embedded generative AI for integration development, accessible directly in the Designer. No other on-premises-compatible ETL/ELT platform offers this capability. Text-to-pipeline generation enables Citizen Integrators (business analysts) to build integrations without deep technical expertise — reducing backlog and accelerating delivery.

- **Informatica migration expertise**: SnapLogic was founded by Informatica's co-founder. The company has completed 50+ Informatica PowerCenter migrations for enterprise customers. Automated conversion tools and proven methodologies reduce migration risk and accelerate time-to-value.

- **Professional Services capability**: 40+ PS consultants globally across AMER and EMEA. DACH-region delivery available in German. Large SI partner ecosystem (Cognizant, Capgemini, Infosys, Blue Altair — 50+ certified consultants) extends capacity for large-scale programmes.

- **Security and compliance**: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2013 certified. GDPR compliant. Ground Plex on-premises deployment ensures ITAR compliance for defense/aerospace customers. Annual penetration testing. Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).

[BOX:blue]
**Why SnapLogic vs Continuing Informatica**

AI-first integration platform with SnapGPT (no competitor offers this on-premises). Modern cloud-native architecture on OpenShift. Citizen Integrator enablement reduces backlog. Flexible licensing (subscription or perpetual). Proven migration path with 50+ completed projects.
[/BOX]

[BOX:jade]
**On-Premises Data Sovereignty**

Ground Plex executes all pipelines within Airbus's data center. No customer data egress. Manager (cloud) handles only metadata. Single outbound HTTPS (port 443) — no inbound firewall rules required.
[/BOX]

[BOX:orange]
**Informatica Migration Expertise**

Founded by Informatica co-founder. 50+ completed PowerCenter migrations. Automated conversion tools. Proven methodology. Parallel run capability for risk-free cutover.
[/BOX]

[BOX:navy]
**Prof. Services — EMEA/DACH Capability**

40+ PS consultants globally. DACH delivery in German. Large SI partner ecosystem. Fixed-price and T&M engagement models. Managed services for ongoing support.
[/BOX]

[BOX:jade]
**Enterprise Maturity & Scale**

$100M+ ARR (August 2025). 21+ customers at $1M+ annually. 600+ enterprise customers. 5T+ records processed monthly. Founded 2006 — 18+ years enterprise software delivery.
[/BOX]

[BOX:purple]
**Security: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR**

SOC 2 Type II certified. ISO 27001:2013 certified. GDPR compliant. ITAR-ready via on-premises deployment. Annual penetration testing. AES-256 + TLS 1.3 encryption.
[/BOX]
